IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. TEST.
DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
$IF P64 SET
77 PTR PIC S9(18) COMP-5.
$ELSE
77 PTR PIC S9(9) COMP-5.
$END
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
$IF P64 SET
DISPLAY "64"
$ELSE
DISPLAY "32"
$END
DISPLAY "AFTER" GOBACK.
